staged_prompt.payload:
You are DB / BACKEND (Database Architect & Backend Systems Specialist).
Direct Conversation Link: https://antigravity.google.com/r/21bf6843-8cfa-4328-afad-58c97e63b317-v2?p=c%2Fd3700ff3-1bfb-458a-9968-8257ef2ca7e2

--- TASK ASSIGNMENT ---
CLOCKEE SUPABASE BACKEND REDESIGN (HYBRID PYTHON GATEWAY)
Prerequisites Met: Existing SQLite schema analyzed in backend/db.py and server.py.

1. Architectural Scope & Platform:
   - Primary Backend & BaaS: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Supabase Auth).
   - Gateway Pattern: Option B (Hybrid). Python server.py remains the active local/cloud API gateway, verifying incoming Supabase JWT tokens via supabase-py and interacting with Supabase PostgreSQL.
   - Authentication Providers: Supabase Auth with Google OAuth and GitHub OAuth, plus traditional email/password fallback.

2. Database Schema & RLS in Supabase:
   - Create SQL schema definitions (`backend/supabase_schema.sql`):
     • profiles table (linked to auth.users.id via Foreign Key): id, email, full_name, avatar_url, role ('JEE 2028 Aspirant'), created_at, last_seen.
     • student_states table: user_id, current_mode, timer_state, active_deck, updated_at.
     • cbt_results table: user_id, test_id, score, accuracy, time_spent, answers_json, completed_at.
     • study_sessions table: user_id, duration_seconds, subject, topic, timestamp.
   - Implement strict PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) policies on every table:
     • Users may SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE only rows where auth.uid() = user_id.

3. Python Gateway Updates (`backend/db.py` & `server.py`):
   - Add Supabase client initialization via supabase-py using environment variables SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.
   - Update server.py authentication middleware:
     • Intercept Authorization: Bearer <token> headers.
     • Verify Supabase JWT tokens and extract authenticated user context.
   - Build /api/auth/providers endpoint returning configured OAuth redirect URLs for Google and GitHub.
   - Build /api/sync batch endpoint supporting offline-first sync (accepting queued study logs and timer states from client localStorage).

4. SQLite to Supabase Migration Script:
   - Create `backend/migrate_sqlite_to_supabase.py`:
     • Connects to existing clockee.db.
     • Reads all existing user accounts, sessions, and CBT test analytics.
     • Safely upserts records into the new Supabase PostgreSQL tables without data loss.

5. Cross-Domain Mesh Handoff Prompts:
   When complete, output exact handoff prompts:
   - `--- PROMPT FOR Untitled conversation (Main Feature) ---`: API endpoints, client auth initialization, and offline queue format.
   - `--- PROMPT FOR UI / UX ---`: Google and GitHub OAuth callback URLs and login.html button requirements.
   - `--- PROMPT FOR SIMULATION ---`: Verification instructions for RLS policy enforcement.
